correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the candidate-deletion mapping to a path, checked that t mod 2 equals spatial parity displacement and therefore edge conductances become stationary on the deleted path. The harmonic current formula for hitting endpoint-neighbor 1 before n-1, then the strong Markov decomposition, gives P(L=k)=u*r0/R[0:n-2]+(1-u)*r[n-1]/R[1:n-1]. For odd n the two boundary resistances and m-pair denominator cancel u, proving the exact parity law and TV. For even n the stated affine weights and uniform O(m^-2) expansion yield the half-sized Riemann integral. The cover time is a.s. finite for 0<p<1. Independent whole-visited-set absorbing Markov systems verified n=3..6 at p=1/5,7/10, including P(L=1,2,3,4)=(.4,.1,.4,.1) for n=5,p=.2. Finite tests are corroboration only.
